explanation: Write r=√(x²+y²). The upper cone has outward vector area element ⟨x/r,y/r,1⟩ dA, giving flux integrand −(4−r)y/r+2y=3y−4y/r. The downward-oriented bottom contributes −2y. Adding gives y−4y/r, option e. All choices integrate to zero over the symmetric disk D, but e directly combines the surface contributions.
